state.objective: Resolve ambiguous navigation details for a concrete compact Finance menu in frontend-hub.
fixed_context: One PT Perorangan; all units are sites of the same entity.
HO centrally controls Finance and every company bank account.
Units cannot access bank accounts, select GL accounts, make manual journals, or transact unit-to-unit.
Unit operational cash tasks live in Operations/Store; Finance receives their evidence and exceptions.

Supplier master and PO live in GA/Procurement; physical asset register lives in GA; employee/payroll inputs live in HR; inventory quantities and movements live in Inventory; selling terms live in Commercial.
Finance owns AP validation, Treasury/payment execution, settlement and bank reconciliation, asset accounting, tax, GL, close and financial reporting.
System/subledger posting is the default. Manual journals are exceptional and restricted.

The first Jev pass selected a hybrid compact HO Finance model with 95% confidence, role-specific overview with 100%, role-filtered navigation with 100%, one Reports screen with 100%, restricted COA with 99%, restricted posting rules with 98%, dedicated Tax for Finance roles with 97%, and restricted Financing with 99%.

Current active Finance has 14 rows: Overview; Supplier bills; Payments; Cash & bank; Charges without a sale; Assets; Journal; Reports; Ledger; Chart of accounts; Line categories; Account map; Giro printing; Period close.
Target should minimize search and cognitive load while preserving distinct jobs and segregation of duties.

accept_candidate_shape.instructions: Is the proposed 13-row role-filtered Finance menu an appropriate final base?

criteria.yes: It matches the stated ownership, system-posting model, and cognitive-load goal.
criteria.no: A materially different top-level structure is required.

ap_not_bills.instructions: Should the current Supplier bills row be renamed Accounts payable and contain bills, matching and aging as views?

criteria.yes: Use Accounts payable as the work domain and keep bill details inside it.
criteria.no: Keep Supplier bills as the top-level name.

payment_instruction_nested.instructions: Should Payment instruction be a view/queue inside Payments rather than a separate sidebar row?

criteria.yes: It is a stage of controlled Treasury execution.
criteria.no: It needs a separate persistent destination.

giro_config_nested.instructions: Should giro layout configuration live as a restricted Bank Account setting while printing is an action on an approved payment?

criteria.yes: Separate configuration from transaction action and remove the Giro printing sidebar row.
criteria.no: Keep Giro printing as a persistent sidebar row.

cash_bank_one_row.instructions: Should Cash & bank remain one sidebar row with nested views instead of six persistent rows?

criteria.yes: The views share a money/reconciliation workspace and role filtering can hide unauthorized bank actions.
criteria.no: Cash, cash count, banks, accounts, transactions and reconciliation require separate rows.

cash_status_in_finance.instructions: Should Cash & bank in HO Finance show read-only unit cash status and exceptions while cash recording remains in Operations/Store?

criteria.yes: Finance needs oversight and reconciliation without duplicating unit data entry.
criteria.no: Remove all unit-cash information from Finance.

bank_accounts_as_view.instructions: Should Bank Accounts be a restricted view/settings area inside Cash & bank rather than a sidebar item?

criteria.yes: It is infrequent master maintenance within the bank workspace.
criteria.no: It needs a top-level persistent menu.

unmatched_nested.instructions: Should Charges without a sale move from a dedicated row into Cash & bank exceptions and Finance Overview alerts?

criteria.yes: It is an exception queue within settlement/bank reconciliation.
criteria.no: Keep it as a permanent top-level item.

asset_accounting_row.instructions: Should Finance rename Assets to Asset accounting, while GA owns the physical register and custody?

criteria.yes: The label makes Finance's scope explicit.
criteria.no: Finance should retain a generic Assets row.

manual_journal_row.instructions: Should an authorized General Accounting user have a persistent Manual journals row?

criteria.yes: Exception journals are a distinct controlled job and need a visible queue/history.
criteria.no: Journal creation should exist only as an action within Ledger.

manual_label.instructions: For that restricted screen, should the label explicitly be Manual journals rather than Journal?

criteria.yes: It distinguishes exceptional human entries from system-generated postings.
criteria.no: The shorter Journal label is clearer enough.

reports_and_ledger_separate.instructions: Should Reports and Ledger remain two separate sidebar rows?

criteria.yes: Statements/aging and account-entry investigation are distinct user jobs.
criteria.no: Combine them into a single screen.

trial_balance_reports.instructions: Should Trial Balance be a view under Reports instead of the default Ledger view?

criteria.yes: It is a period/report balance view.
criteria.no: It should be the default unfiltered Ledger view.

sales_register_crosslink.instructions: Should Sales Register be owned by Sales/Commercial while Finance Reports provides an authorized cross-link/read view rather than a separate duplicate implementation?

criteria.yes: One source and two authorized entry points avoid duplicate logic.
criteria.no: Finance should maintain a separate sales-register implementation.

coa_row.instructions: Should Chart of accounts remain a restricted Finance sidebar row for General Accounting/Finance Manager roles?

criteria.yes: Natural-account governance is an infrequent but real accounting responsibility.
criteria.no: Hide it entirely from navigation.

posting_rules_merge.instructions: Should Line categories and Account map be merged into one restricted Posting rules screen?

criteria.yes: They jointly translate business meaning into governed ledger posting and unmapped exceptions.
criteria.no: They require separate persistent rows.

tax_row.instructions: Should Tax remain a role-visible Finance row rather than only a checklist inside Period close?

criteria.yes: Obligations, filings and reconciliation form an ongoing workflow.
criteria.no: The current volume is adequately served inside Reports and Period close.

prepaids_nested.instructions: Should Prepaids & accruals be a view/work queue within Accounts payable and Period close, with individual schedules opened as records rather than a sidebar row?

criteria.yes: This preserves the schedule subledger without adding persistent navigation.
criteria.no: It needs its own top-level workspace.

advances_nested.instructions: Should advances be views within AP or AR based on party/purpose, with aging and settlement, rather than one generic top-level Advances row?

criteria.yes: The owning obligation/receivable workflow provides the correct context.
criteria.no: All advances need one top-level menu.

financing_row.instructions: Should Financing be a restricted row with separate Bank loans and Owner capital/drawings views?

criteria.yes: Both are infrequent but distinct from routine payments and manual journals.
criteria.no: They should be handled only through Payments or Journal.

one_period_close.instructions: Should readiness, controls, certification, approval, and close/reopen actions be combined into one Period close workspace?

criteria.yes: They are stages of one controlled close process.
criteria.no: Controls & close and Period close require separate rows.

payroll_linked_views.instructions: Should payroll inputs and calculation remain in People while Finance sees linked payroll payable, payment and accounting reconciliation views?

criteria.yes: This follows process ownership and segregation of duties.
criteria.no: Move the full payroll workflow into Finance.

inventory_linked_review.instructions: Should inventory valuation and movement stay in Inventory while Finance Overview/Period close links to exceptions and accounting review?

criteria.yes: Inventory owns operations; Finance owns accounting certification.
criteria.no: Duplicate Inventory Accounting as a complete Finance menu.

unit_no_finance_nav.instructions: Should ordinary unit users have no central Finance sidebar and instead see their cash, deposit, petty-cash and sales-reconciliation tasks in Operations/Store?

criteria.yes: Role ownership and bank restrictions remain clear.
criteria.no: Units require a Store section inside Finance.

auditor_readonly_same_screens.instructions: Should auditors use the same authorized Finance screens in read-only mode instead of a separate auditor menu tree?

criteria.yes: The same records and evidence should be inspected without alternate navigation logic.
criteria.no: Build a distinct Finance navigation tree for auditors.

role_based_count.instructions: What persistent row count should be targeted for a normal Finance role after role filtering?

criteria.six_to_eight: 6-8 rows, with specialized controls visible only when assigned.
criteria.twelve_to_thirteen: All 12-13 proposed rows for every Finance role.
